## Constraint check

- [ ] Browser-only — no backend / serverless / database needed.
- [ ] Free forever — no paid API / vendor.
- [ ] Public repos only — works without OAuth or a private token.
- [ ] Rule-based — no AI / LLM inference for findings.

If any box is unchecked, the feature belongs in the
anti-roadmap. Please explain why this is an exception
or propose a constraint-respecting variant.
